deviations.description: Splice the implicit own-task-directory member into file_scope_json immediately after the read, unconditionally.
deviations.reason: Splicing unconditionally before the length>0 guard would make the guard's own length check always >=1 (since the implicit directory is always appended), causing the excursion check to run even for tasks with NO declared file_scope -- directly contradicting this plan's own Non-Goal ('Widening the length > 0 guard so the check also runs for an empty declared file_scope ... is scope creep'). Implemented instead: task_dir_rel is derived right after the read (as specified), but the actual array splice happens on a local effective_file_scope_json used only by the jq comprehension, inside the existing guard -- so the guard's trigger condition (based on the ORIGINAL file_scope_json) is unchanged, while every task that already declares a non-empty file_scope gets the exemption.
